variants.label: Variant A: BM25 Only
variants.description: Lexical BM25 chunk retrieval without dense SVD, applicability rules, protocol segmenter, JEV, dependency DAG, or constrained planner.

variants.label: Variant B: Standard Hybrid RAG (No Protocol / Applicability)
variants.description: Hybrid BM25+SVD+Structured RRF retrieval with 1D marginal investigation overlap and naive JEV/greedy planning; omits protocol & applicability engine.

variants.label: Variant C: Static Row Matcher
variants.description: Row-level 1D O2/P/flow/material/geometry/gravity tolerances without protocol history, GasRole, unknown!==unknown, assumed provenance cap, or joint envelope checks.

variants.label: Variant D: Full EMBER v2
variants.description: Complete hybrid RRF + calibrated jev-v1.0 + stage-bound ProtocolStep matcher + 9 applicability rules + multi-layer verifier + dependency DAG + exact planner.

ablations.label: Ablation: Full EMBER minus Protocol Engine (RULE-PROT-01)
ablations.description: Disables stage-bound protocol history & operator shutoff vs physical extinction separation.

ablations.label: Ablation: Full EMBER minus Geometry Engine (RULE-GEOM-01)
ablations.description: Disables thermally-thin film vs thick slab vs cylindrical rod & enclosure scale checks.

ablations.label: Ablation: Full EMBER with Collapsed Outcomes
ablations.description: Collapses endpoints to legacy binary outcome presence (ignores flow_turned_off / cool-flame / particle-size distinction).

ablations.label: Ablation: Full EMBER minus JEV Passage Evaluator
ablations.description: Replaces calibrated jev-v1.0 passage evaluator with uncalibrated constant routing.

ablations.label: Ablation: Full EMBER with BM25-only Retrieval
ablations.description: Replaces hybrid BM25+SVD+Structured RRF retrieval with BM25-only retrieval.

capabilityMatrix.label: Multi-investigation PSI discovery & metadata filtering
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Standard PSI exploration workflow shared across hackathon submissions; only EMBER v2 has executable local adapter unless external CLI env hooks are provided.

capabilityMatrix.label: Stage-bound protocol segment matching (operator shutoff vs physical extinction, cool flame)
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Requires row-level ProtocolSteps + Events separating initial spread from flow_shutoff/cool-flame stages.

capabilityMatrix.label: Mandatory GasRole separation (ambient cabin vs oxidizer_stream inverse burner O2)
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Prevents ACME-CFI-G 85% O2 burner stream data from validating ambient cabin atmospheres.

capabilityMatrix.label: Gravity mode separation (actual_flight vs simulated_analogue E-FIELD vs 1g)
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Enforces explicit zero partial-g PSI coverage and blocks ACME E-FIELD lunar transfer claims.

capabilityMatrix.label: Joint multi-dimensional (O2, P, flow) coverage vs 1D marginal range warning
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Detects empty multi-dimensional regions inside overlapping 1D min/max parameter bounds.

capabilityMatrix.label: RULE-UNK-01 strict unknown !== unknown discipline
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Prevents null-null test fields (e.g., Saffire-III S1 vs S2, unknown thickness) from falsely matching.

capabilityMatrix.label: Calibrated atomic JEV conflict-preserving passage routing (jev-v1.0)
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Evaluates Q1/Q2/Q3 separately with calibrated probabilities and never drops contradictions.

capabilityMatrix.label: Live design-variant dependency DAG recalculation (thickness/flow/atmosphere)
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Propagates parameter patches across rules to emit retained/weakened/invalidated edges and impact chains.

capabilityMatrix.label: Exact branch-and-bound test programme planner preserving controls & replicates
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Optimizes coverage score under mandatory control and >=2 replicate constraints.

capabilityMatrix.label: Group-CV domain-gated single-endpoint numeric predictor
capabilityMatrix.evidenceNote: Refuses out-of-domain or below-baseline numeric predictions instead of extrapolating unconstrained.
